title: Python REST APIs With Flask, Connexion, and SQLAlchemy – Part 3
description: Extend your Flask REST API with a SQLAlchemy one-to-many relationship that adds notes to people, and serve them through new API endpoints.
summary: Most modern web applications are powered by a REST API under the hood. That way, developers can separate the front-end code from the back-end logic, and users can interact with the interface dynamically.
takeaways: You’re also testing your API with Swagger UI API documentation that you’re building along the way.
Planning Part Three In part one of this series, you built your REST API.
Working through part two , you connected your REST API to a database.
